name: worked-examples
title: Worked examples
description: "More worked examples" cards: a task, a collapsible solution, and buttons that load the example into a widget.

solutionLabel.description: Text for an empty or missing <summary> in details.exm-sol.

loadLabel.description: Text for a load button left empty in the markup.

numbering.description: Fill each empty .exm-n with its number on the page (cards that already have text are left alone).

numberLabel.description: Text for automatic numbering; {n} is the card's position on the page.

eventName.description: Name of the CustomEvent a load button dispatches on its target. Change it if a target is an element that fires native load events (img, iframe, svg).

scroll.description: Scroll the target into view after loading (smooth unless the reader prefers reduced motion).

flashMs.description: How long the target keeps the exm-flash highlight, in milliseconds; 0 = no highlight.

selector.description: CSS selector of the load buttons the package wires up. A matched element needs data-target and either data-load or data-load-<key> attributes; anything else is left to the page's own script.

fillFields.description: When the loaded value is an object, write each key into the target's form controls that have a matching data-field or name (firing input and change), before the load event.
